title: 76 days: OpenAI is switching Cursor off after the $60B SpaceX deal
description:
76 days: OpenAI is switching Cursor off after the $60B SpaceX deal

On August 28 OpenAI said it intends to wind down the contract that serves its models to Cursor, with a proposed shutoff date of November 12, 2026. That is 76 days, and OpenAI says it is the maximum notice the contract provides.

The trigger was ownership. SpaceX closed its acquisition of Cursor's maker on August 14 in an all-stock deal valued at about $60B, and OpenAI's agreement gave it a limited window to cancel after a change of control. It used the window.

Cursor was running at roughly $3B a year with more than a million paying customers at the time of the deal. What those developers get on day 77 has not been said by anyone.
